faqs.q: How many short-term rentals can one owner operate, and how many days a year can it be rented?
faqs.a: One owner may operate up to three short term rental properties within the City. However, only one reservation is allowed per property at a time. A short-term rental can only be occupied for up to 240 days per calendar year. At the end of each year, a Short-Term Rental Log will need to be submitted to the City verifying the number of days that a rental was occupied.
